summary: Require an inherited, independent, single-writer board contract for every current and future EKODI board while retaining board-specific categories and existing records.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly instructed on 2026-10-08 that the independent board policy become a forced execution rule for all EKODI boards and instructed continued implementation and verification.

approvalEvidence.ownerInstruction: 좋아 에코디의 모든 게시판에 대한 강제실행규칙으로 설정해줘

mandatoryRules: independent board engine owns board content and CRUD; platform owns identity handoff and routing
one canonical write-store per board; legacy services cannot double-write
per-board versioned category contracts, preserving all existing category keys and posts
equivalent slash/no-slash navigation, refresh and trusted post-login return
server-side authorization and protections for restricted operations
CI regression gate and real production evidence required before completion
validation: real canonical production verification after gated deployment
rollback: Any modification or rollback requires a subsequent recorded constitutional amendment; never delete existing posts or weaken access enforcement as a workaround.
